name: lasso
description: Local-first source library and writing assistant with versioned evidence

scripts.desktop:test:browser: LASSO_BROWSER_GEOMETRY_TEST=1 npm run desktop && node desktop/tests/browser-geometry.mjs
scripts.desktop:test: swiftc -O -module-cache-path /tmp/lasso-swift-module-cache -framework Cocoa -framework WebKit -framework PDFKit -o /tmp/lasso-anchor-tests desktop/ShareInsertion.swift desktop/SyntheticKeyboard.swift desktop/WorkspaceAPI.swift desktop/NativeMaterial.swift desktop/NotchPanel.swift desktop/AssistActivation.swift desktop/TransientDismissal.swift desktop/DirectoryColors.swift desktop/CompletionTransaction.swift desktop/AssistSourceIdentity.swift desktop/ModelPreview.swift desktop/DependencyReference.swift desktop/DependencyOverlay.swift desktop/HostGeometry.swift desktop/WebText.swift desktop/HostTextAdapter.swift desktop/NodeRuntime.swift desktop/tests/main.swift && /tmp/lasso-anchor-tests
